note: Wikimedia Commons, “Saint Meletios of Antioch Dionysiou.jpg”; artist as recorded there: Tzortzis Phouka — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: A fresco at the Dionysiou monastery on Athos which Commons names for Meletios of Antioch, the patriarch this folder holds. The qualifier is in the file's own title, so it is not the Meletios of Kharkov or of Lardos the same Russian day also prints. Commons describes it: Fresco of Saint Meletios of Antioch from Dionysiou Monastery
